title: Fading Grandeur premieres on Netflix on 23 October, starring Antonio de la Torre and Alexandra Jiménez
body_markdown:
Entertainment


17 September 2026


Global


Spain


Link copied to clipboard


[Download the first images](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/00b8b6ff-c18d-4a6f-adea-628b1780959a)


[Discover the trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=duhj1D_BCT4)


Netflix today unveiled the premiere date, trailer and first-look images for


Fading Grandeur


, a new comedy created by


Álvaro Fernández-Armero


and


Juan Cavestany


. The series will premiere globally on Netflix on


October 23, 2026.


This six-episode dramedy stars


Antonio de la Torre


and


Alexandra Jiménez


. Don Leandro, a ruined marquis who lives on appearances and dreams of being named a Grandee of Spain, sees only one way out of his financial disaster: selling his decaying family mansion in Madrid. The perfect opportunity seems to arise when the immensely wealthy businesswoman Sofía Carrington takes an interest in the property. But as the negotiations (and seductions) progress, it becomes clear that they are not who they appear to be.


The cast also includes


Enric Benavent


(


My Heaven, Your Hell


,


The Unit


),


Fernando Andina


(


Dreams of Freedom


,


Oasis


),


Teresa Rabal


(


For One Hundred Million


,


The Sand Box


),


Mercedes Sampietro


(


My Friend Eva


,


Oasis


) and


Celia de Molina


(


Cochinas


,


Urban: Life Is Ours


), among others.


Produced by


Cuidado con el perro


, the series is directed and written by


Álvaro Fernández-Armero


(


Spanish Affair 3


,


Everything Is a Lie


) and


Juan Cavestany


(


Vote for Juan


,


Madrid, Ext.


), who have previously worked together on projects including


Shame


and


We’re Sorry for the Inconvenience


. Both also serve as executive producers alongside


Alicia Yubero


.


About Cuidado con el perro


Cuidado con el perro is a film and television production company founded by Álvaro Fernández-Armero, Juan Cavestany and Alicia Yubero following the success of


Shame


(2017–2020). They subsequently completed two seasons of


We’re Sorry for the Inconvenience


, released the feature films


An Optical Illusion


,


Still Life with Ghosts


and


Madrid, Ext.


, and continue to develop new formats.


Fading Grandeur


is their first series for Netflix.
